sections.Profile:
Big Ben , released by Williams in April 1975, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Landmark, Single Player, Travel, United Kingdom, London, 1970s, Single level playfield

- Design: Steve Kordek
